name: COCO-WholeBody: Whole-Body Human Pose Estimation Benchmark
description: COCO-WholeBody is the first comprehensive benchmark for whole-body human pose estimation, annotating 133 keypoints per person (17 body, 6 foot, 68 face, and 42 hand keypoints). Built atop MS COCO 2017 images by SenseTime and CUHK, it provides unified keypoint annotations for over 250,000 human instances across 123,287 images, enabling unified detection of full human pose, expressions, and gestures.
